# Guide to the Inventory, Scheduling, and Disposition of Federal Records

This guide is for federal agency records management staff. It contains information to help agencies schedule and dispose of their records. It also provides information on the process for approving records schedules. Contact your agency's appraiser if you have further questions.

Download the [PDF](https://www.archives.gov/files/records-mgmt/scheduling/isd.pdf)

### [Records Basics](https://www.archives.gov/records-mgmt/scheduling/basics)

### [Records Value](https://www.archives.gov/records-mgmt/scheduling/values)

## Scheduling and Appraisal Process

Scheduling and appraisal is a process that takes place in a certain order:

### [1 - Knowing Your Records](https://www.archives.gov/records-mgmt/scheduling/knowing)

### [2 -](https://www.archives.gov/records-mgmt/scheduling/sch-record) [Scheduling Records](https://www.archives.gov/records-mgmt/scheduling/sch-records)

### [3 - Internal Clearances and External Approvals](https://www.archives.gov/records-mgmt/scheduling/approval)

### [4 -NARA Appraisal and Approval](https://www.archives.gov/records-mgmt/scheduling/nara-review)

### [5 -Implementing Schedules](https://www.archives.gov/records-mgmt/scheduling/implementation)

### [6 -Updating Schedules](https://www.archives.gov/records-mgmt/scheduling/updates)
